paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是父母希望孩子擅长某件事。曼尼很快就发现了自己的天赋，而大人们却比他本人还要兴奋得多。

曼尼最近开始学习击剑，而且很快就表现得非常出色。全家人都来看他参加比赛，杰尤其骄傲。曼尼连续赢下了好几场，成功进入决赛。

他最后的对手是一个女孩，于是曼尼说自己想退出。他觉得打败一个女孩是不对的。格洛丽亚起初支持他的决定，但听清原因后，她告诉曼尼，拒绝和女孩比赛本身才是不尊重对方。曼尼于是同意继续比赛。

接着，杰和格洛丽亚得知，那个女孩已经失去了父母，目前正在一家儿童医院接受治疗。当医院里的其他孩子赶来为她加油时，两个人顿时觉得特别内疚。他们想向曼尼示意，让他手下留情，可曼尼误会了，以为他们希望自己尽快结束比赛。他轻松取胜，还当着女孩的面大肆庆祝。杰一开始很愧疚，不过那座巨大的奖杯很快就让他心情好了起来。

看到杰如此为曼尼骄傲，米切尔想起了一段童年往事。小时候，他和克莱尔曾组成一支名叫“火与冰”的双人滑冰队。克莱尔在一场重要比赛前突然退出，米切尔多年来一直因此责怪她。

卡梅隆推动他们终于把这件事说开。克莱尔解释说，米切尔练习时一直把她摔下来，她退出是因为不想让他在所有人面前出丑。她也为自己当时处理事情的方式道了歉。米切尔随后承认，自己真正怀念滑冰，是因为那让他们感觉像一个团队。父母离婚后，两个人渐渐疏远，也经常站在不同的一边。克莱尔明白了他的感受，于是姐弟俩在没有冰面的情况下，再次表演了一遍当年的滑冰动作。

与此同时，菲尔担心曼尼已经找到了自己擅长的事，而卢克却还没有。他让卢克尝试棒球和其他活动，但卢克似乎没有在哪一项上特别有天赋。

后来，菲尔带着卢克一起去给客户介绍一套房子。卢克兴奋地谈起后院和几个卧室，把房子说成了一个非常适合孩子生活的地方。菲尔突然意识到，卢克可能继承了自己推销房子的天赋。

到了最后，曼尼得到了一座巨大的奖杯，米切尔和克莱尔重新找回了团队的感觉，而菲尔也明白，当他不再拼命寻找时，卢克的天赋反而会自然地显现出来。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about parents wanting their children to be good at something. Manny finds his talent very quickly, while the adults become far more excited about it than he does.

Manny has recently started fencing, and he turns out to be excellent at it. The whole family comes to watch one of his competitions, and Jay is especially proud. Manny wins several matches and reaches the final.

His last opponent is a girl, so Manny says he wants to quit. He thinks beating a girl would be wrong. Gloria first supports his decision, but when she hears the reason, she tells him that refusing to compete with a girl is actually disrespectful. Manny agrees to continue.

Then Jay and Gloria learn that the girl has lost both her parents and is being treated at a children’s hospital. When other children from the hospital arrive to cheer for her, they start feeling terrible. They try to signal Manny to go easy on her, but he misunderstands and thinks they want him to finish the match quickly. He wins easily and celebrates right in front of her. Jay feels guilty, although the enormous trophy soon cheers him up.

Seeing Jay so proud of Manny brings back an old memory for Mitchell. When he and Claire were children, they competed together as an ice-skating team called “Fire and Nice.” Claire quit just before an important competition, and Mitchell has blamed her ever since.

Cameron pushes them to finally talk about it. Claire explains that Mitchell kept dropping her during practice, and she quit because she didn’t want him to embarrass himself in front of everyone. She apologizes for how she handled it. Mitchell then admits that the real reason he misses skating is that it made them feel like a team. Since their parents’ divorce, they’ve grown apart and often taken different sides. Claire understands, and the two of them perform one last skating routine together, without any ice.

Meanwhile, Phil worries that Manny has found something he’s great at while Luke hasn’t. He tries baseball and other activities, but Luke doesn’t seem especially talented at any of them.

Later, Phil takes Luke with him while showing a house to a client. Luke talks excitedly about the backyard and the bedrooms, and he makes the house sound like an amazing place for children. Phil suddenly realizes that Luke may have inherited his talent for selling.

By the end, Manny has a huge trophy, Mitchell and Claire feel like a team again, and Phil learns that Luke’s talent appears naturally when he stops trying so hard to find it.
